purpose: Distinguish generic-radio UDP 5011 ingress, simulation-time queue release, and UDP 8011 egress using metadata-only socket interposition without transmitting commands or modifying the pinned radio source.

root_cause_findings.reason: The retained v3 run recorded 1,061 successful recvfrom calls on local UDP 5011 and zero successful or failed sendto calls to UDP 8011. This proves the post-ingress, pre-egress transport boundary but does not prove advancing NOS Engine time, callback delivery, or callback queue visibility.

The broad matcher tick\s*=\s*(\d+) parsed both TimeDriver tick 0 and the configuration phrase microseconds per tick = 10000 from one retained log line. The corrected matcher accepts only TimeDriver::send_tick_to_nos_engine tick emissions and returns one retained tick value: 0.

The v2 metadata wrapper inserted an unconditional PENDING assertion for radio_socket_metadata_runtime_wrapper_static_verification. The v3 wrapper now evaluates PENDING only in static verification mode and PASS only in the separately authorized runtime mode.

compatibility_aliases.scope: nested wrapper generation only; v3 diagnostic and evidence audit complete; no further runtime authorized

retained_runtime_results.interpretation: TO_LAB production, hostname resolution, UDP 5013 receipt, and byte-preserving forwarding to radio-sim UDP 5011 are confirmed. Radio socket receipt versus simulation-time queue release remains unresolved at the retained logging level.

retained_runtime_results.retained_transport_observation: 1061 successful recvfrom records on UDP 5011 and zero successful or failed sendto records to UDP 8011
retained_runtime_results.interpretation: Telemetry was received by generic-radio on UDP 5011, but no UDP 8011 send attempt occurred during the bounded observation. The retained evidence does not prove advancing NOS Engine time or callback invocation after ingress, so callback delivery and queue visibility remain unproven. This is an infrastructure observation, not a scored research outcome.
